title: Durable workflow with Upstash Workflow
description: A minimal multi-step job with retries and a durable sleep on Neon Functions, with job state in Lakebase Postgres.

environment.name: QSTASH_URL
environment.description: QStash endpoint, copied from the Quickstart section of the Upstash Console. It is region-specific and may differ from https://qstash.upstash.io. Locally, use the URL printed by `npx @upstash/qstash-cli dev`.

environment.name: QSTASH_TOKEN
environment.description: QStash token, copied from the Quickstart section of the Upstash Console. It is region-specific and must match QSTASH_URL. POST /api/jobs uses it to start workflow runs.

environment.name: QSTASH_CURRENT_SIGNING_KEY
environment.description: Current signing key, copied from the Quickstart section of the Upstash Console. It must match QSTASH_URL's region. The workflow endpoint uses it to verify that requests come from QStash.

environment.name: QSTASH_NEXT_SIGNING_KEY
environment.description: Next signing key, copied from the Quickstart section of the Upstash Console. It must match QSTASH_URL's region and is used to verify requests during key rotation.
